name: Pyromancer: Phoenix is dismissed immediately after changing specialization (#13390)
contract: #13390: Phoenix Egg 800796 (CharacterAdvancement entry 29189, Flameweaving spec 37, requiring Ember Touch
30206 and Flameweaving 4038) summons creature 50258 with SummonProperties 1561 (SUMMON_CATEGORY_PET,
SUMMON_TYPE_PET), creating a controllable Guardian in player->m_Controlled rather than a Hunter-style Pet
(GetPet() is null). AscensionClassService::SwitchSpecialization only called RemovePet() and omitted
UnsummonAllTotems() and RemoveAllControlled() (unlike Player::ActivateSpec and AscensionFreepick), and
npc_ascension_pyromancer_summon never checked HasSpell(800796), so the Phoenix stayed active and kept
casting periodic heals (707110) after leaving Flameweaving for Draconic (spec 39) or switching to a second
specialization slot. Asserted: after summoning Phoenix in Flameweaving (slot I), switching to specialization
slot II (979994) and choosing Draconic (39) immediately dismisses creature 50258 (owned_creature_count 0,
pet_entry 0) and delivers 0 Phoenix heals (707110) over 7 s; returning to slot I, resummoning Phoenix, and
switching directly to Draconic (39) likewise dismisses 50258 immediately.

steps.label: Let login state settle
Choose Flameweaving (37) on slot I
Buy Ember Touch (30206) prerequisite
Buy Phoenix Egg (29189 -> 800796)
SETUP: Phoenix Egg 800796 is known in Flameweaving
Summon the Phoenix
SETUP: Phoenix 50258 is summoned and occupies the pet slot
Unlock specialization slot II
Switch to specialization slot II (979994)
Let the 5 s specialization swap cast finish
Slot II is active
Choose Draconic (39) on slot II
Phoenix Egg 800796 is no longer known in Draconic
DISCRIMINATING: Phoenix 50258 is dismissed immediately after switching to Draconic via slot II
DISCRIMINATING: pet slot is empty after switching to Draconic
Injure the Pyromancer to confirm no stray Phoenix heals arrive
Wait past one 5 s Phoenix heal tick
DISCRIMINATING: no Phoenix periodic heals land after spec switch
Player health remains unchanged with no stray Phoenix heal
Return to Flameweaving slot I (979993)
Let the 5 s specialization swap cast finish
Phoenix Egg 800796 is restored on slot I
Resummon the Phoenix in Flameweaving
Phoenix 50258 is active again
Switch directly from Flameweaving (37) to Draconic (39)
DISCRIMINATING: direct specialization change immediately dismisses Phoenix 50258
DISCRIMINATING: pet slot is empty immediately after direct specialization change
